description: Feature A — read-only pre-run auth gate that classifies the GCRS SIW transport before a run wastes time, plus a Docs note for both features. At preflight, run the SAME existing read-only SIW probe ONCE to classify GCRS as mcscli (healthy) / edge-fallback (fragile) / unknown, surface it as additive sub-keys in run.summary['preflight'] and as a new additive 'auth_gate' key in run_controller.preflight_state(), and log a human-readable WARNING when the run would be forced onto the fragile Edge fallback. Warn-only: do NOT hard-block the run (existing require_midway gate behavior unchanged). The probe must NEVER crash preflight (fully try/excepted) and must NOT open the single Edge automation profile (use mode='mcscli' so it only probes mcscli; a mcscli probe failure classifies as edge-fallback without launching Edge). Browser-lane (SCC/PNAMA/DSR) sign-in is recorded as 'unknown — verified when the lane runs' with a reason, because a reliable check would require opening the Edge profile that preflight treats as a hard error. This feature is INDEPENDENT of FEAT-001 (different files, no ordering dependency).
steps: In tools/run_daily.py preflight(): after the existing checks dict is built and the existing require_midway / edge_profile / template / builder_mcp / mcscli logic runs, compute a best-effort GCRS transport classification. Wrap the WHOLE block in try/except Exception so it can never raise out of preflight. Inside: import siw_client; session = siw_client.FailoverSiwSession(mode='mcscli', log=run.log); then in a try/finally call session.ensure_ready() and read session.transport_name -> 'mcscli'; except siw_client.TransportError -> 'edge-fallback'; finally session.close(). Any other exception from the outer wrap -> 'unknown'. Set checks['auth_gate'] = {'midway_session_valid': checks['midway_session_valid'], 'gcrs_transport': <classification>, 'browser_signin': 'unknown', 'browser_signin_reason': 'not checked at preflight to avoid opening the single Edge automation profile'}. Log run.log('WARNING: GCRS will use the fragile Edge fallback (mcscli SIW probe failed); one bad batch previously blanked gcrs+polygon+ads — see #G8') when gcrs_transport is 'edge-fallback' or 'unknown', else an INFO line that GCRS has the fast mcscli lane. Do NOT change any existing checks key, the require_midway raise, or any other preflight behavior.

In tools/web/run_controller.py: add a module-level _auth_gate_safe() helper modeled on _environment_checklist_safe() that computes the same four-key dict using siw_client.FailoverSiwSession(mode='mcscli') (ensure_ready + transport_name, TransportError -> 'edge-fallback'), wrapped so it NEVER raises — on any failure return {'midway_session_valid': midway_session_valid(), 'gcrs_transport': 'unknown', 'browser_signin': 'unknown', 'browser_signin_reason': '...'}. In preflight_state(), add a new top-level key 'auth_gate': _auth_gate_safe() to the returned dict. Do NOT remove or rename any existing preflight_state key (midway_ok, edge_profile_exists, edge_profile_busy, edge_stale_locks, mcscli_present, ready, environment_checklist all stay).

Add offline tests in tests/test_web_controller.py (patch run_controller's siw_client.FailoverSiwSession; no network): (a) preflight_state() returns an 'auth_gate' dict with the four sub-keys AND all existing keys still present; (b) a patched session with ensure_ready succeeding and transport_name=='mcscli' -> gcrs_transport=='mcscli'; (c) ensure_ready raising TransportError -> gcrs_transport=='edge-fallback'; (d) ensure_ready raising a generic Exception -> gcrs_transport=='unknown' and preflight_state() still returns (never raises).

Add an offline run_daily preflight test (in tests/test_polygon_workflow.py or tests/test_web_controller.py, patching siw_client.FailoverSiwSession) asserting run.summary['preflight']['auth_gate'] is populated after preflight(require_midway=False, require_builder_mcp=False) and that a probe raising an exception does not break preflight (preflight still returns its checks dict). Use a minimal Run-like object or the real Run with a tmp dir; stub midway/edge/template checks as needed by patching or by using require flags.

Document both features: add a dated entry to Docs/changes.md (Feature A read-only preflight auth gate / gcrs_transport classification; Feature B per-batch Edge retry + degrade-to-errored citing the 2026-10-04 Failed-to-fetch run). Append to #G8 in Docs/edge-cases.md that a single Edge /grbi batch now retries up to 3x with 2s/4s/6s backoff and, if still failing, is recorded as errored for those TIDs while remaining batches continue. Inclusive language only.
acceptance_criteria: run.summary['preflight']['auth_gate'] exists with keys midway_session_valid, gcrs_transport ('mcscli'|'edge-fallback'|'unknown'), browser_signin ('unknown'), browser_signin_reason; no existing preflight check key removed/renamed.

run_controller.preflight_state() returns a new top-level 'auth_gate' key with the same four sub-keys; all pre-existing keys (midway_ok, edge_profile_exists, edge_profile_busy, edge_stale_locks, mcscli_present, ready, environment_checklist) remain unchanged.
The probe is wrapped so an exception never crashes preflight or preflight_state (degrades to 'unknown'); mode='mcscli' means the Edge automation profile is never opened at preflight.
A WARNING is logged when gcrs_transport is edge-fallback/unknown; the run is NOT hard-blocked on this (require_midway gate behavior unchanged).
Docs/changes.md and Docs/edge-cases.md describe both features; inclusive language respected.
Running `py -3.13 -m pytest tests/test_web_controller.py -q` passes including the new Feature A tests.
verification: py -3.13 -m pytest tests/test_web_controller.py -q  (all pass, new tests included)
py -3.13 -m pytest tests -q  (full suite; expected >= 68 passed, must be >= 64)
findings: Implemented in tools/run_daily.py preflight(): after the existing checks dict and existing require_midway/edge_profile/template/builder_mcp/mcscli logic, added a fully try/excepted block that imports siw_client, builds FailoverSiwSession(mode='mcscli', log=run.log), calls ensure_ready() inside try/except siw_client.TransportError (-> 'edge-fallback') /finally session.close(), reads transport_name on success. Sets checks['auth_gate'] = {midway_session_valid, gcrs_transport ('mcscli'|'edge-fallback'|'unknown'), browser_signin:'unknown', browser_signin_reason}, re-assigns run.summary['preflight']=checks, and logs a WARNING ('GCRS will use the fragile Edge fallback ... see #G8') when edge-fallback/unknown, else an INFO line. Any exception from the outer try (including FailoverSiwSession construction itself raising) is caught and still sets checks['auth_gate'] with gcrs_transport='unknown' plus a short log line, so preflight() can never crash and never hard-blocks (require_midway behavior untouched, no existing checks key removed/renamed). In tools/web/run_controller.py added _auth_gate_safe() mirroring _environment_checklist_safe()'s wrap-everything style, using the same FailoverSiwSession(mode='mcscli') probe (lambda no-op logger) and returning the same four-key dict; on any exception it falls back to {midway_session_valid: midway_session_valid(), gcrs_transport:'unknown', browser_signin:'unknown', browser_signin_reason}. preflight_state() now returns an additive top-level 'auth_gate': _auth_gate_safe() key; all pre-existing keys (midway_ok, edge_profile_exists, edge_profile_busy, edge_stale_locks, mcscli_present, ready, environment_checklist) are unchanged. mode='mcscli' means EdgeInPageTransport/the Edge automation profile is never constructed by this probe in either file. Tests: added 4 new tests to tests/test_web_controller.py (auth_gate present with all 4 sub-keys plus all existing preflight_state keys; mcscli classification; TransportError -> edge-fallback; generic Exception during FailoverSiwSession construction -> 'unknown' and preflight_state still returns) by monkeypatching the real siw_client module's FailoverSiwSession. Added a new PreflightAuthGateTests class to tests/test_polygon_workflow.py with 2 tests (mcscli classification populates run.summary['preflight']['auth_gate'] via run_daily.preflight(require_midway=False, require_builder_mcp=False); a FailoverSiwSession constructor raising RuntimeError still returns preflight()'s checks dict with gcrs_transport='unknown'). Documented both FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 in Docs/changes.md (new 2026-10-04 dated entry) and appended a 'Mitigations (2026-10-04)' paragraph to #G8 in Docs/edge-cases.md covering the per-batch Edge retry/degrade and the new preflight auth gate. Verification: `py -3.13 -m pytest tests/test_web_controller.py -q` -> 23 passed; `py -3.13 -m pytest tests -q` -> 82 passed (required >= 64, expected >= 68 with FEAT-001+FEAT-002 tests — exceeded). No existing preflight_state or run.summary['preflight'] key was removed or renamed; BATCH_EDGE/BATCH_MCSCLI, /grbi sequential ordering, ADS single-file upload, column removal, and remark logic are untouched (this feature only touches tools/run_daily.py's preflight(), tools/web/run_controller.py, and the two test files).
